name: Abacaxi Ricaço
description: Discover how to make an Abacaxi Ricaço using Pineapple (fresh), Light gold rum 1-3yo, Lime juice and Superfine/caster sugar in 6 easy to follow steps

instructions_raw.name: Prepare glass
instructions_raw.text: Select and pre-chill a PINEAPPLE SHELL (FROZEN) GLASS.

instructions_raw.name: Prepare garnish
instructions_raw.text: Cut the top off a small pineapple and carefully scoop out the flesh from the base to leave a shell with 12mm (½ inch) thick walls. Place the shell in a freezer to chill.

instructions_raw.name: Prepare garnish
instructions_raw.text: Cut a straw sized hole in the sliced off top of the pineapple shell for use as a lid.

instructions_raw.name: BLEND
instructions_raw.text: Remove the hard core from the pineapple flesh and discard; roughly chop the remaining flesh, add other ingredients and BLEND with one 12oz scoop of crushed ice.

instructions_raw.name: POUR
instructions_raw.text: POUR into the pineapple shell. (The flesh of one pineapple blended with other ingredients will fill two shells.)
